gloss: after a bath; fresh out of the bath

definitions.gloss: after a bath; fresh out of the bath
definitions.explanation: The state or moment immediately after getting out of the bath. Used to describe both the time period and the refreshed physical state that follows bathing.

examples.japanese: {風呂上|ふろあ}がりのビールは{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: A beer after a bath is the best.

examples.japanese: {風呂上|ふろあ}がりに{肌|はだ}が{乾燥|かんそう}しないように{保湿|ほしつ}する。
examples.english: I moisturize after bathing so my skin doesn't dry out.

examples.japanese: {風呂上|ふろあ}がりの{子|こ}どもたちがパジャマに{着替|きが}えて{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The children, fresh out of the bath, are running around in their pajamas.

notes:
Composed of {風呂|ふろ} (bath) + {上|あ}がり (coming out of, finishing). Describes the period or state immediately after taking a bath. Bathing culture is central to Japanese daily life, and this word captures a familiar, pleasant moment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がりのビール: a beer after a bath
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がりに{飲|の}む: to drink after a bath
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がりの{肌|はだ}: skin right after bathing
- {風呂上|ふろあ}がりにストレッチする: to stretch after bathing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {湯上|ゆあ}がり: after bathing — essentially the same meaning but uses {湯|ゆ} (hot water) instead of {風呂|ふろ}; sounds slightly more refined
- {入浴後|にゅうよくご}: after bathing — more formal and clinical, used in medical or skincare instructions

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {風呂上|ふろあ}がりのビール (a beer right after the bath) and {風呂上|ふろあ}がりの{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう} (milk after the bath, especially at public baths) are iconic pleasures of daily life.
